item.title: Popular Cyborg-Style ROG Gaming Chairs Arrive in Japan! Featuring the ROG Destrier Ergo and Standard ROG Destrier Core With Sound-Insulating Panels - Saiga NAK
item.description: ASUS announced that it will release the popular cyborg-style ROG Destrier Ergo Gaming Chair and ROG Destrier Core Gaming Chair on Friday, March 27, 2026.

item.title: Yohji Yamamoto's Apparel Brand WILDSIDE and Yakuza/Like a Dragon Collaborate on Tattoo Design Shirts and More! Sales Start March 25 - Saiga NAK
item.description: The fourth collaboration collection between WILDSIDE, an edgy conceptual brand by world-renowned fashion designer Yohji Yamamoto, and Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio, the creators of the Yakuza/Like a Dragon series, has arrived! item.title: The Smartphone Version of the Popular Mystery Adventure Game Urban Myth Dissolution Center Is Now Available! Featuring Frame Functions and Touch Controls - Saiga NAK
item.description: Shueisha Games Inc. has released the iOS and Android versions of the mystery adventure game Urban Myth Dissolution Center. It has been available since Thursday, March 19, 2026, and can be purchased from the App Store and Google Play.

item.title: Blue Mary Confirmed to Join Fatal Fury: CotW on March 26, 2026! Character Trailer Released! - Saiga NAK
item.description: DLC character Blue Mary will join SNK Corporation's fighting game Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves (hereafter Fatal Fury: CotW) starting Thursday, March 26, 2026! Character trailers have been released in Japanese and English.

item.title: GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE- Ver. 2.00 Update Announced! Jam Kuradoberi Finally Joins the Fight! - Saiga NAK
item.description: Arc System Works Co., Ltd. announced a major update for the popular fighting game GUILTY GEAR -STRIVE-! New elements, including the new character Jam Kuradoberi, have been revealed all at once.

item.title: Review of KURAND's Hana Okuru Rose Wine and Flower Veil -Hana to Umeshu-: Perfect Mother's Day Gifts! - Saiga NAK
item.description: We once again participated in KURAND's media-exclusive new product tasting event. We tried the new products, brimming with a sense of spring: Hana Okuru Rose Wine and Flower Veil -Hana to Umeshu-!

item.title: Bushiroad Booth Report From AnimeJapan 2026! Latest Works From Weiβ Schwarz and Bushiroad Creative on Display - Saiga NAK
item.description: AnimeJapan 2026, one of the world's largest anime festivals, was held at Tokyo Big Sight on Saturday, March 28 and Sunday, March 29, 2026. This time, we are reporting on the Bushiroad booth!

item.title: Razer Viper V4 Pro, Razer's Popular Gaming Mouse, in Short Supply; Backorders Recommended for Early Access - Saiga NAK
item.description: Razer Japan株式会社は、2026年3月25日(水)に発売した大人気ゲーミングマウス「Razer Viper V4 Pro」が品薄状態になっているとお詫びを発表。予想以上の人気により一部店舗およびオンラインストアでは在庫切れが発生しており、現在は生産および供給体制の強化を急いでいるとのことです。

item.title: CAPCOM SPRING SALE Is Underway Until April 22! Nintendo Switch 2 Version of Resident Evil Village Is on Sale for the First Time! - Saiga NAK
item.description: Capcom is currently holding the CAPCOM SPRING SALE on the PlayStation Store, Nintendo eShop, Xbox Games Store, and Steam Store. You can purchase numerous titles, including classic titles recently released on the Steam Store, at great prices.

item.title: HoYoverse Begins Participant Recruitment for New Petit Planet Beta Test, “Starfrift Test,” on PC, iOS, and Android - Saiga NAK
item.description: HoYoverse has started recruiting participants for the “Starfrift Test,” a beta test for the new slow-life game Petit Planet. The test is scheduled to begin on Tuesday, April 21, 2026, for PC, iOS, and Android.

item.title: Ingrid Joins the Fray as Street Fighter 6 Year 3’s Fourth DLC Character! Teaser Video Now Available - Saiga NAK
item.description: Ingrid has been confirmed as the fourth DLC character for Street Fighter 6 Year 3! The final character of Year 3 will arrive in late spring 2026.

item.title: PowerA Kirby-Design Nintendo Switch 2 Peripherals Are Also Coming to Japan! Wireless Controller and Storage Case Lineup - Saiga NAK
item.description: PowerA has announced a Kirby-designed wireless controller and protection case compatible with the Nintendo Switch 2 in Japan. They will be released on Friday, May 29, 2026.

item.title: LevTech Confirmed as Special Sponsor for EVO Japan 2026! Tournament Name to Be EVO Japan 2026 presented by LevTech - Saiga NAK
item.description: The EVO Japan 2026 Executive Committee announced that LevTech has joined as its top partner. The tournament name has been set as EVO Japan 2026 presented by LevTech.

item.title: LITTLE NIGHTMARES II Enhanced Edition Coming to Switch 2 on May 29! Enhanced Graphics, 3D Audio, and More - Saiga NAK
item.description: The suspense adventure game LITTLE NIGHTMARES II Enhanced Edition will be released on the Nintendo Switch 2 on Friday, May 29, 2026. This title is a digital-exclusive release, offering a deeper experience of the nightmare world through enhanced graphics and 3D audio compared to the original version.

item.title: Xbox FanFest 25th Anniversary World Tour Confirmed! To Be Held in 8 Cities Worldwide Including Seattle - Saiga NAK
